nodes.description: Skeletal development is disturbed, with hypoplastic or late-ossifying epiphyses, metaphyseal dysplasia and variable vertebral changes. Radiographs may show fragmented or crescent-shaped distal femoral epiphyses. Genu valgum and scoliosis can progress, while some epiphyseal abnormalities improve with age; normal height and preserved ambulation occur in milder skeletal-ocular presentations.
